meta.description: Create a free Puntr account with your email and a password. 18+. No card.

join.title: Join Puntr
join.subtitle: Free to join. No card. Takes a minute.

emailStep.label: Email address
emailStep.terms: By continuing you agree to the <1>Terms</1> and have read the <2>Privacy notice</2>.
emailStep.codeInstead: Email me a sign-in code instead

codeStep.title: Enter your code
codeStep.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It can take a minute to arrive.

onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.subtitle: Two minutes. Your username is public.
onboarding.usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: a to z, 0 to 9 and underscores. This is shown on your public record.
onboarding.invalid: Use 3 to 20 letters, numbers or underscores
onboarding.birthYearHint: Used only to confirm you are 18 or older.
onboarding.accept: I accept the <1>Terms</1> and have read the <2>Privacy notice</2>.
onboarding.marketingEmail: Email me news and offers from Puntr (optional)
onboarding.marketingWhatsapp: WhatsApp me news and offers from Puntr (optional)
onboarding.publicRecord: Your picks are a public, permanent record. They are locked at kick-off and cannot be edited or deleted.

done.full: Founding spots are full. You're in as a member.
done.body: Your account is ready. Post your first pick before kick-off.
done.unconfirmed: You're in. Founding spots are full or held for early-access members.
done.confirmPrompt: Signed up for early access? Confirm your email to claim your Founding spot.

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.code: That code isn't right or has expired. Check it or ask for a new one.
error.rate: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.ageRequired: Please confirm that you are 18 or older.
error.consentRequired: Please accept the Terms and Privacy notice to continue.
error.yearInvalid: Enter a valid year of birth.
error.under18: You must be 18 or older to use Puntr. We have not kept your details.
error.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
error.credentials: That email and password don't match. Check them, or ask for a sign-in code.
error.exists: That email already has an account. Use Sign in, or ask for a sign-in code.

password.long: That password is too long. Use 72 bytes or fewer.
password.sameAsEmail: Your password can't be your email.
password.common: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer phrase.
